item.content:encoded:
I think this (and by "this", I refer to the subject of the article (the term most commonly used to describe a page on this website (scp-wiki.net, a large collaborative fictional writing archive of works that are generally staged in the same universe (by "universe", I mean it in the sense that one would call the setting and context of a story a "universe")) that hosts information about an SCP object (SCP standing for "Special Containment Procedures"; the common belief that it is also an initialism (the more accurate term for what most people call an acronym; it is only technically an acronym if the letters are said together, as if forming a word, such as in the example of SCUBA (self-contained underwater breathing apparatus, a widespread tool for use in exploration of areas wherein there is no breathable air (usually composed primarily of nitrogen, with oxygen being the second most prevalent element as well as the one most used by the human body), specifically areas where one is fully submerged in the world's oceans; this includes journeys made for scientific purposes, which makes it very much relevant to the SCP (Special Containment Procedures) Foundation)) for "Secure, Contain, Protect" (the motto (essentially, a statement of the purpose and methodologies of a given organization, simplified into a form short enough to be known and understood by even the least intelligent members of the corresponding organization) of the SCP Foundation) is in fact false, because the initialism was devised prior to the development of the Foundation's motto), which is true of the page to which the comments section in which you are presumably reading this post belongs) that I am currently referring to) is my spirit animal.

…And now my head hurts. I'm kind of glad to know I'm not normally that much of an overexplainer.

item.title: Shit, sorry everybody.
item.content:encoded:
It was a joke thing on a chat subchannel that I forgot to edit back. That it was on April 1st is a coincidence. Somebody said something about how hot Velma from Scooby Doo was, and then they were talking about SCP-erotica, and the topic immediately before that was 184-j.

So I tied them all together.

I never got a PM though, or I'd of taken care of it sooner. I got alerted through chat by a user, and didn't even know about this thread. I appreciate the call Ixscoerz. I'm sure you'll get a mention on the dedication page of my six-volume erotica collection, available June, 2014.

… I can put it back if anyone thought it was funny.

item.title: Mod Post
item.content:encoded:
After review, referees staff is unsure as to whether or not the edit was an April Fool's prank or an actual intended edit to the SCP that happened to be made on the 1st. We are reverting to the original April 1st version until the author can be reached for final judgment.

Cain, whenever you see this: In the future, when you make April Fool's edits, please add an edit comment explaining that it should be reverted after the 2nd.

Ixscoerz, your mistake was innocent enough, but in the future, please contact staff if you believe there's an issue rather than making an edit beyond SPaG (spelling, punctuation, and grammar). Also, you too should have left an edit comment explaining what you were doing. Just notice for the future.

Five yard penalty, repeat third down.
